SpecialThingFilterDef.label: automatic outfit apparel
SpecialThingFilterDef.description: Allow Work and Non-Work selections, retained outfit stock, borrowed garments and exact saved personal items tagged Automatic saved apparel. Enabling this filter also enables their currently known item types. Item, condition, quality and other storage filters still apply. Remove or Clear keeps stock in this category; use Forget to release unused types.

SpecialThingFilterDef.label: non-automatic outfit apparel
SpecialThingFilterDef.description: Allow apparel outside automatic outfit selections, retained stock, borrowed gear and saved personal outfits. Another ordinary copy of a saved garment remains in this category unless its type is selected or retained.

Remove or Clear keeps stock in this category; use Forget to release unused types.

SpecialThingFilterDef.label: non-automatic outfit weapons
SpecialThingFilterDef.description: Allow weapons outside automatic outfit selections, retained stock, borrowed gear and saved personal outfits. Another ordinary copy of a saved weapon remains in this category unless its type is selected or retained.
